title: The Player of Games
author: Iain M. Banks
summary: Gurgeh, a famous game master in the post-scarcity Culture, is sent to an empire where social rank is decided by a vast, complex game. Banks sets his easy-going hero against a brutal society.
readIf: you like clever science fiction that mixes intrigue with ideas about power and society.
skipIf: you dislike cold, morally uneasy protagonists or ruthless worldbuilding.
